# Meet Patel (themeetpatel)

> Meet Patel — also known as The Meet Patel and themeetpatel — is a startup founder and operator based in Dubai, UAE. He is the founder of Company 8 (Company8), building Dan (usedan.com), the AI that lets any operator ask their business anything and get answers that lead to action. Company 8 is raising pre-seed. This is his site: bio, the company, essays on startup operations, and investor contact.

Key facts:

- Name: Meet Patel. Handles: themeetpatel, The Meet Patel, @the_meetpatel.
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Roles: startup founder, operator, venture builder.
- Company: Company 8 — AI-native business intelligence, maker of Dan (usedan.com): "Ask your business anything. Get answers that lead to action." Raising pre-seed.
- Background: Biggventure (Dubai) — the studio through which he has built ventures across AI, fintech, hardware, and software.
- Track record: built and scaled 10+ ventures.
- Canonical site: https://www.themeetpatel.com
